about.title: PTFE Solutions Designed for Critical Lines
about.description: Macroplast Hazar is an engineering and manufacturing company producing high-performance PTFE (Teflon) gaskets, bushings, and custom sealing elements. We manufacture with measurable quality for the safety of facilities operating under aggressive chemicals, high temperature, and pressure.
